packageRules.description: The lab's Python packages move with Pyodide, which ships them for the browser
Refreshing that lock would move its packages too, and an update to the whole lock has no package name to match
The gallery's Dockerfile demo is text in a component, which Renovate takes for a Dockerfile by its name
A lab project's packages are those its stages are checked with, and its Python packages move with Pyodide, so learners run what the browser runs
Major @types/node updates move with the Node version in .node-version
